name: Wraith
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the wraith has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wraith makes two Life Drain attacks.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken, and the wraith regains hit points equal to that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a Long Rest. The target dies if this attack reduces its Hit Point maximum to 0 and, a day later, rises as a Specter under the wraith's control unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed.

actions.name: Create Specter
actions.description: The wraith targets a humanoid within 10 feet of it that has died within the last minute as a result of the wraith's Life Drain. The target's spirit rises as a Specter in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The Specter is under the wraith's control. The wraith can have no more than seven Specters under its control at a time.

description: Wraiths are incorporeal shadows of hatred and vengeance, draining the life from the living and raising their victims as spectral thralls to swell their spectral ranks.
